scoring_justification: Step 01: recompute the saddle-point equations using the submitted q0,q1 values and check they are a fixed point; step 02: recompute transition temperatures from the submitted curves and compare to reported values. No trust in self-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Model parameters and equations are encoded in the checker code; no separate hidden files.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact equations from the paper.

outputs.description: The temperature dependence of the spin-glass order parameters q0 and q1 for each n value. The checker will compute the mean absolute error between the submitted curves and a hidden reference solution; meeting or beating the threshold (MAE < 0.02) earns full credit.
The estimated transition temperatures T_P_SG1 and T_SG1_SG2. The checker will compare the submitted values to hidden gold values within a tolerance of ±0.05.

output_contract.notes: The task is a minimal reproduction of the replica-symmetric phase diagram analysis. It does not require full Langevin dynamics simulations.

steps.description: Verify that submitted (T,q0,q1) points satisfy the saddle-point equations (fixed-point consistency).
Check that the reported transition temperatures are correctly derived from the submitted q0(T), q1(T) curves.
